blurb.bm: Rumah Agam Biru di Lebuh Leith, dicat dengan kapur dan pewarna nila.
blurb.en: The Blue Mansion on Leith Street, coloured with lime and indigo dye.

ask.bm: Kenapa Rumah Agam Cheong Fatt Tze berwarna biru?
ask.en: Why is the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion blue?

opts.en: Paint from a factory in Europe

why.bm: Betul! Kapur dicampur pewarna nila. Dinding kapur menyerap lembapan dan membantu rumah kekal sejuk.
why.en: Right! Lime mixed with indigo dye. The lime walls soak up moisture and help keep the house cool.

intro.bm: Saudagar Cheong Fatt Tze membina rumah agam ini di Lebuh Leith. Ramai memanggilnya Rumah Agam Biru.
intro.en: The merchant Cheong Fatt Tze built this mansion on Leith Street. Many people call it the Blue Mansion.

bm: Pembinaan bermula pada 1897 dan siap pada 1904.
Ada 38 bilik, 5 halaman berlantai granit dan 220 jendela kayu.
Warna birunya datang daripada kapur yang dicampur pewarna nila (indigo).
Selepas dipulihara, ia menerima anugerah pemuliharaan warisan UNESCO pada 2000.
en: Building started in 1897 and finished in 1904.
It has 38 rooms, 5 granite-paved courtyards and 220 wooden louvre windows.
The blue comes from lime mixed with indigo dye.
After its restoration it won a UNESCO heritage conservation award in 2000.

fun.bm: Rumah agam ini muncul dalam filem, termasuk Crazy Rich Asians.
fun.en: The mansion has appeared in films, including Crazy Rich Asians.
